reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid, has expired, or has already been used. Request a new one.
reset.tooMany: Too many reset attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For connecting other apps, like Home Assistant. A key acts as you in one household, with only the access you give it.
apiKeys.noneHint: Make one to connect another app.
apiKeys.makeDescription: For {{household}}. It stops working if you leave the household.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.permissionsHint: Give only what the app needs. Managing the household always needs a sign-in.
apiKeys.madeDescription: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe. It won't be shown again.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: It stops working straight away. Anything using it will need a new key.

mcp.permissions: Start with read access. To allow suggestions, give write access to Recipes, Plan or Shopping list. Meal suggestions also need read access to Recipes. Plan read access includes dietary preferences. MCP changes wait in Review. This is a regular API key: its write permissions also allow changes through the REST API.
mcp.connect: Choose Streamable HTTP in an app that accepts a bearer token. Use the URL above and send this value in its Authorization header. Your AI app must be able to reach your Merran server. Suggestions appear in Recipes → Review; Merran does not use your AI credits for MCP calls.

myData.title: Your data
myData.description: Your account, the households you're in, the cooking notes you wrote and your API keys' names and permissions (never the keys), as a file to keep. A household's recipes are in its export.

share.title: Share to Merran
share.description: Add a recipe from any app on your phone: share its web page or a link to it, or photos, screenshots or a PDF of it, to Merran. Share a receipt the same way, and it waits on the Pantry page to be looked over.
share.androidSteps: In Chrome, open the menu (⋮) and tap Install app or Add to home screen. Then, in any app, tap Share and pick Merran: a link, a page, photos, screenshots or a PDF.
share.needsHttps: This needs Merran opened at its https address, not a local one like this.
share.iphoneIntro: Apple only lets App Store apps into the share sheet, but a Shortcut can be there instead. It takes a few minutes to set up, once.
share.makeKey: Make a key for the Shortcut

steps.create: Open Shortcuts, tap +, and name it Send to Merran.
steps.shareSheet: Tap ⓘ and turn on Show in Share Sheet.
steps.fetch: Add the action Get Contents of URL, with this address:
steps.method: Tap the arrow beside it, and set Method to POST. Under Headers, add Authorization, with this:
steps.body: Under Request Body, pick Form, add a File field named file, and set it to Shortcut Input.
steps.message: Add Get Dictionary Value, for the key message.

share.after: Now, in Safari or any app, tap Share, then Send to Merran. A notification says what was added.
share.keyNote: The key can only add recipes, to {{household}}, and it's yours: someone else needs their own. It's in your API keys, where it can be removed.

planning.description: The meals Fill the week and Plan each week fill for you: all of them, unless you turn some off. Every meal still shows on the plan, so you can plan one you've turned off yourself whenever you like.

members.removeDescription: They lose access to this household straight away. They can come back with a new invite link.
members.leaveDescription: You lose access to it straight away. To come back, you'll need a new invite link.

invites.emailDescription: Send a single-use invitation that lasts seven days. Only the invited email address can accept it.
invites.emailUnavailable: Ask the server administrator to configure Email and the server's public address. You can still make and share an invite link.
invites.emailQueued: Invitation queued. You can follow its status in the invitations list.
invites.title: Invitations
invites.description: Each invitation works once, for 7 days. Mail service acceptance does not confirm inbox delivery.
invites.noneHint: Make a link to invite someone.

invites.roleHint: Admins can change the household's settings and invite people.
invites.madeDescription: Copy it now and send it. It won't be shown again.

new.title: Start another household
new.description: As a server admin, you can start more households. You'll own it and switch to it.

tastes.title: Tastes
tastes.description: What your household eats and doesn't. Fill the week and the autoplan keep to it. Anyone in the household can change it.
tastes.avoidHint: Leave it out: recipes with it are still suggested, with it crossed off and not bought, unless it's what the dish is, like mushroom risotto. Never: recipes with it aren't suggested. Nor are allergies, and nuts, dairy, gluten, eggs and meat get the diet labels' careful check (pesto has nuts, butter is dairy), so they can't just be left out.

themes.title: Theme nights
themes.description: A theme for each night's dinner, like taco night or fish on Friday. Fill the week suggests dinners that fit: tagged or named for it, vegetarian for meatless, never made for something new. Leftovers and eat-out nights stay empty.
themes.tagPlaceholder: A tag, like curry or burgers

autoplan.title: Plan each week
autoplan.description: On the day and hour you pick, the week ahead's empty meals fill themselves from your recipes, the way Fill the week does: keeping to your tastes and theme nights, saying why for each, and never changing a meal that's planned.
autoplan.on: Plan the week ahead for us
autoplan.off: Off. Turn it on to have each week planned before it starts.
autoplan.whenHint: In the household's time zone. It plans the next week to start that day or later.
autoplan.addToList: Put what those meals need on the list
autoplan.noIdeas: No ideas for {{week}}: nothing new in your recipes fits.

nutrition.title: Nutrition for the library
nutrition.descriptionUsda: New recipes get their nutrition by themselves. For ones that came in without it, work it out from USDA's data.
nutrition.descriptionAi: New recipes get their nutrition by themselves. For ones that came in without it, AI can estimate it.
nutrition.allDone: Every recipe with servings has its nutrition.

photos.title: AI photos
photos.description: Photos of the finished dish for recipes without one, all in one style so your library looks like one cookbook. They never replace a real photo.

stores.modalityHint: Prices and what's in stock can differ between them.

about.title: This server
about.noAddress: Not set, so links use the address in the browser

email.title: Email
email.description: Connect your SMTP provider for household invitations and password recovery.
email.enabledHint: Off by default. Complete and save the SMTP settings before sending a test.
email.tlsHint: Turn on for port 465. Turn off for STARTTLS, usually port 587. Both modes require encryption and valid certificates.
email.usernameHint: For a trusted relay without authentication, leave both username and password unset.
email.passwordHint: Use the credentials supplied by your email provider.
email.passwordSet: A password is saved. Leave this unchanged to keep it, or enter a replacement.
email.testHint: Save changes first. The test goes to your account email address. Provider acceptance does not guarantee inbox delivery; check spam and your provider dashboard.
email.accepted: The mail service accepted the test email. Check your inbox and spam folder.

setup.title: Connect an email provider
setup.provider: Get your provider's SMTP host, port and credentials, and authorize a sender address or verify your sending domain.
setup.resend: For Resend: host smtp.resend.com, port 465, TLS from the start on, username resend, and your API key as the password. Use a sender on your verified domain.
setup.test: Save the settings, enable email, then send yourself a test. Other providers use the same fields with their own SMTP values.

errorTracking.title: Error tracking
errorTracking.description: Send errors from the server and from browsers to your own Sentry, GlitchTip or Bugsink. Reports leave out cookies, keys and who was signed in.
errorTracking.dsnHint: From your error tracker's project settings. Leave it empty to keep errors in the server's log only.
errorTracking.environmentHint: To tell this server's errors apart from others'.
errorTracking.saved: Saved. Browsers pick it up when they next open Merran.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: An anonymous summary once a day helps the Merran project see how many servers run it, on which versions, and which parts get used.
telemetry.send: Send an anonymous summary once a day
telemetry.never: Never names, recipes, keys, or anything anyone typed.
telemetry.installIdHint: The install id is random. A new one means later summaries can't be linked to earlier ones.
telemetry.lastUnreachable: Couldn't reach the Merran project on {{day}}. Merran tries again tomorrow.
telemetry.lastRefused: The Merran project turned down the summary on {{day}}: {{detail}}
telemetry.lastRetired: The Merran project no longer collects summaries from this version. Update Merran to send them again.
telemetry.totals: See the totals from every server

question.title: Help improve Merran?
question.description: Merran can send the Merran project an anonymous summary once a day: how many servers run it, on which versions, and which parts get used. Never names, recipes, keys, or anything anyone typed.
question.settings: You can see exactly what’s sent, and change your mind, any time in Settings → This server.
question.preview: See exactly what would be sent
question.previewFailed: The preview could not load. You can retry or decide later in Settings → This server → Telemetry.
question.statusFailed: The telemetry choice could not load. Nothing is enabled by this message. Retry, or check Settings → This server → Telemetry.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Work Merran does in the background: imports, emptying Recently deleted, the daily summary. Finished jobs stay here for 30 days.

kinds.purgeDeleted: Emptying old recipes from Recently deleted

video.title: Video import
video.description: Recipes from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook links. yt-dlp reads the caption, captions and pictures, and AI writes the recipe up.
video.install: Both come with the Docker image. Elsewhere, install them, or put them in the data folder's tools folder.
video.cookies: A cookies.txt is set, for sites that want a signed-in session.
video.noCookies: No cookies.txt. Instagram and some YouTube videos may want one: put one from your browser in the data folder.
video.enabledHint: Paste or share a video link like any other.
video.autoUpdateHint: Weekly. It stops working when sites change, and is fixed within days.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Calculate recipe nutrition from ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. A USDA key is free. Without one, households with AI can get an estimate.
nutrition.keyHint: Paste the key api.data.gov sends you. It's tested before it's saved.
nutrition.keySet: A key is saved. Paste another to replace it.

setup.title: Get your USDA key
setup.register: Register for a free FoodData Central API key using your name and email.
setup.email: Look for the key email. If it hasn't arrived, check your spam or junk folder.
setup.paste: Paste the key below and choose Save key. Merran tests it before saving.

sites.title: Recipe sites
sites.description: Merran reads recipe sites' feeds every few hours, as Merran and following robots.txt: the suggested sites, for starter collections, and any a household follows.
sites.notRead: Not read yet: the first read starts a minute after Merran does.
sites.enabledHint: Off, households can't follow sites, and collections keep only what's been read already.

photos.title: AI photos
photos.description: A photo of the finished dish for recipes without one, on a household's OpenAI or Google key: about 1.5¢ a photo with OpenAI, 4¢ with Google. Each household picks how they look. They never replace a real photo.
photos.enabledHint: Households with an OpenAI or Google key can make them, and make them for their whole library.
photos.autoHint: One made by itself for a recipe added without a photo: typed in, read from text, or from the assistant. Never for a library moved in at once.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Who reads cook steps aloud when cooking hands-free. Each step is read once and kept, and if the server's voice fails, the device's reads instead.

hints.device: Each phone, tablet or computer reads in the best voice it has. Nothing leaves the server.
hints.kokoro: Kokoro runs beside Merran, free, and sounds close to a person: the same on every device.
hints.openai: OpenAI's voices, about 1.5¢ a minute of reading, on a household's OpenAI key. Without one, its devices read in their own.

voice.kokoroUrlHint: Where Kokoro answers, like http://kokoro:8880 from the compose file. It may be on your home network.
voice.openaiHint: Hearing a voice costs a fraction of a cent the first time, on your household's OpenAI key.

kroger.title: Kroger
kroger.description: Connect a Kroger developer app so households can find stores, see prices and send their shopping list to a Kroger-family cart.
kroger.redirectHint: Add this to the Kroger app as its redirect URI.
kroger.redirectHere: Add this to the Kroger app as its redirect URI. It's the address you're using now: set the server's public address so it doesn't change.
kroger.secretHint: Both are tested with Kroger before they're saved.
kroger.secretSet: A secret is saved. Paste another to replace it.
kroger.works: It works: Kroger took the app.

setup.title: Create your Kroger app
setup.register: Sign in to the Kroger developer portal and register an application with the Product, Cart and Profile APIs.
setup.redirect: Copy the Redirect address below into your application as its redirect URI.
setup.paste: Copy the Client ID and Client secret into Merran, then choose Save app.

walmart.title: Walmart
walmart.description: Experimental. Households in the US can fill their Walmart cart through Merran's browser extension, which finds each thing and adds it in a Walmart tab of the person's own, at a person's pace. Merran never reaches Walmart itself, and stops whenever Walmart asks whether it's a person.
walmart.switchHint: Off until you turn it on. Walmart has no way in for apps like Merran, so a change to its site can stop this working until Merran catches up.

household.title: Move a household
household.description: Download a household archive or restore one from Merran.

import.newHint: Named and set up as in the export, with you as its owner. You'll switch to it.

spotlight.title: From your sites
spotlight.startTitle: New recipes from sites you like
spotlight.startHint: Follow a recipe site and its newest recipes show up here.

extension.title: Connect the Merran extension
extension.missing: The Merran extension isn't connecting from this page.
extension.missingHint: Click the Merran button in your browser's toolbar and enter this Merran's address: it opens this page and connects from here.
extension.ask: Let the Merran extension work with {{household}}?

can.recipes: Add recipes from the pages you're on, and see its recipes
can.list: See and change its shopping list

extension.revoke: It gets a key of its own, which you can take away any time in Settings, You, API keys. It can't change settings or anyone's account.
extension.connected: Connected. You can close this tab.
extension.connectedHint: Click the Merran button in the toolbar on any recipe's page to add it, or right-click a link or a page.
extension.failed: The extension didn't take the key. Its key is in Settings, You, API keys, to take away; then connect again from the extension.
extension.which: Which household should the Merran extension work with?
extension.whichHint: To work with more than one, connect again from the extension for each: it keeps them all, to switch between.

get.title: Get the extension
get.text: For Chrome, Edge or Firefox: the zip for your browser, from Merran's releases.
get.chrome: Chrome or Edge: unzip it, open chrome://extensions (edge://extensions in Edge), turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and pick the unzipped folder.
get.firefox: Firefox: open about:debugging, choose This Firefox, then Load Temporary Add-on, and pick manifest.json in the unzipped folder. Firefox forgets it when it restarts, until it's in Firefox's add-ons.

connect.title: Connect it to this Merran
connect.text: Click the Merran button in your browser's toolbar (it may be under the puzzle piece) and enter this address. Merran opens to ask you, then this ticks itself off.
connect.other: It's connected to {{households}}, not {{household}}. Click its button in the toolbar, then Add a household.

stuck.title: Done that, and it's not ticking off?
stuck.browser: Open Merran in the browser the extension is in: it only hears Merran's pages in its own browser, not in another browser or app.
stuck.reload: Just installed or updated it? Reload it on your browser's extensions page (chrome://extensions, or edge://extensions in Edge), then reload this page.
stuck.address: Its toolbar button shows the address it's connected to: it has to be {{address}} exactly. localhost and 127.0.0.1 count as different addresses, as does another Merran; enter this one to connect it here too.
stuck.on: Check it's turned on, and allowed on this site, in your browser's extensions page.

onboarding.title: Your first meal
onboarding.description: Start with one meal. Recipes, planning, shopping and cooking work without AI or a store connection.
onboarding.reviewHint: These choices apply to everyone in this household. You can change them in Settings → Household.
onboarding.zoneHint: Suggested from this browser on first review. Check it so Today and your meals use the right local day. UTC is the fallback.
onboarding.unitsHint: Week start and planned meals belong to the household. Recipe display units are a choice on each device.
onboarding.loadFailed: Getting-started progress could not load. Your recipes and other pages are still available.
onboarding.saveFailed: Could not save onboarding progress. Try again.
onboarding.allComplete: You've added a recipe, planned a meal, built a list, and cooked. You're ready for your next meal.
onboarding.optionalHint: Make Merran your own when you're ready. None of these connections are needed for your first meal.
onboarding.adminHint: You administer this server. Invite people from Settings → Household; server and household keys have separate access rules.

resources.householdHint: Preferences, people, stores and AI keys.
resources.importHint: Bring your recipe collection with you.
resources.aiHint: Choose a provider and understand whose key pays.
resources.httpsHint: Set up HTTPS, remote access and installation.
resources.serverHint: Modules, AI policy, jobs and updates.
resources.backupsHint: Keep your data safe and know how to restore it.

recipe.title: Add a recipe
recipe.description: Import a recipe link, write one, or bring recipes from another app. Review imported amounts and steps.

plan.title: Plan a meal
plan.description: Choose a day and meal in Plan, add your recipe, and check the servings.

list.title: Build your shopping list
list.description: In List, add ingredients from the plan and review what your pantry already covers.

cook.title: Cook and mark it made
cook.description: Open your recipe, choose Start cooking, and follow the steps. Mark it made when you finish.

connections.hint: Configuration status only. Test connections in Settings; provider tests may use paid credit.

help.title: Help
help.description: Revisit a tour, read the guide, or see what's new.
help.restore: Show getting started and tours again
help.closeDialog: Close the open dialog before starting a tour.

everyWeek.title: Every week
everyWeek.description: Things you buy each week regardless of the meals planned, like bananas. They join the list when you add the week’s plan.

alwaysOnHand.title: Always on hand
alwaysOnHand.description: Staples you assume are available, such as salt. Merran leaves them off the shopping list.

useSoon.title: Use soon
useSoon.description: Pantry food approaching its best-before date. Check the food itself before cooking.

pool.title: The week’s pool
pool.description: Meals picked for this week without a particular day yet. Move them onto a day when you decide.

themeNights.title: Theme nights
themeNights.description: A theme for each dinner, such as taco night. Fill the week uses these themes when suggesting recipes.

goesWith.title: Goes with
goesWith.description: Recipes you pair together, such as a main dish and a side.

proposals.title: Proposals and Review
proposals.description: Changes suggested by the assistant are proposals. Review them and choose what to apply.

keys.title: Whose AI key pays?
keys.description: Households can use their own provider keys. Server keys are shared only under the administrator’s policy; provider charges go to the key’s account.

shared.navigation: Move between Today, Recipes, Plan, List and Pantry here. On a phone these sections are in the bottom tabs.
shared.help: Come back to Help to replay this tour, restore getting started, or look up a Merran term.
shared.assistant: The assistant is optional. It can suggest changes for you to review; its AI calls use an eligible provider key.
shared.server-settings: This server is for administrators: enable modules, decide AI access, and check jobs and updates. Household preferences live separately.

today.title: Today
today.overview: Today brings together your next meal, the week and what is at home. Your first meal keeps the next steps visible until you hide it.
today.action: Use the checklist to add a recipe, plan a meal, build a shopping list and cook. Review the household time zone before relying on its dates.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.overview: Keep your household’s recipes here. Import a link or write one by hand; neither requires AI when the source has recipe data.
recipes.action: Add a recipe here, then review its servings, ingredients and steps before putting it on the plan.

plan.title: Plan
plan.overview: Pick a day and meal, then choose a recipe and servings. The week’s pool holds meals before you choose a day.
plan.action: Fill the week uses your recipes and preferences. Add planned meals to the shopping list when you are ready.

list.title: List
list.overview: The household’s shopping list combines ingredients and accounts for food at home. You can also type an item directly.
list.action: Add ingredients from the plan, review the quantities, and check off purchases. A store connection is optional.

pantry.title: Pantry
pantry.overview: Track food in the fridge, freezer and cupboard. Amounts and dates help with shopping and using food in time.
pantry.action: Add what is at home, including amounts where possible. Always on hand is for staples you assume you have.

recipe.title: Your recipe
recipe.overview: Review the ingredients, servings and steps here. Display units can be changed without rewriting the original recipe.
recipe.action: Choose Plan it to plan this recipe, or Start cooking for the step-by-step view. Cooking guidance is offered here so a tour never interrupts you at the counter.

settings.title: Settings
settings.overview: You contains personal choices. Household contains shared preferences. Administrators also have This server for server-wide configuration.
settings.action: Review your household’s time zone, week start and planned meals. Invite links bring people into this household; they do not need the server setup code.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.overview: Ask for ideas about your kitchen when AI is configured.
assistant.action: Review proposed changes before applying them.

help.assistantTour: Show me how the assistant works

shopping.title: Shopping mode
shopping.nothingHere: Nothing else to find here. Review the items set aside or try another store.
shopping.everythingBought: Everything on this list is bought.
shopping.troubleHint: Keep it needed, find it elsewhere, or choose a replacement.
shopping.finishHint: Items still needed stay on the household list for later.
shopping.adjustedHint: Shopping substitutions are saved for this planned meal. The library recipe may be different.

swap.title: Replace {{name}}
swap.hint: Choose a replacement, review its quantities and instructions, then apply it.
swap.allRecipes: This replacement includes every planned recipe that needs this item. Review each recipe’s amounts and instructions below.
swap.noIdeas: No replacement worked across all these recipes. Try again or enter replacements for each recipe below.
swap.contextFailed: Couldn’t load the planned meals. Try again before replacing anything.
swap.noActiveMeals: There are no editable planned meals for this item. Review the item’s details or set it aside.
swap.manualItem: This item has no planned recipe. A replacement changes this shopping item only.
swap.replacement: Replacement lines, with amounts for the recipe as written
swap.keepStep: Keep this step, updating ingredient names automatically
swap.listHint: Shopping quantities include the selected meals’ servings and pantry deductions. Other meals and bought items stay separate.
swap.saveLibrary: Save this replacement to the library recipe too
swap.libraryHint: This also changes the saved recipe for future use. Its previous version is kept.
swap.mealHint: Only the selected planned meals change. Your library recipe stays as it is.
swap.applied: Replacement saved and shopping list updated.

shopping.contextMismatch: This recipe does not belong to the selected planned meal. Open the meal from Plan again.
shopping.adjustedNutrition: Nutrition and cost estimates for the library recipe do not include this meal’s substitutions.
